storeInfo.name: Franco Gianni's
storeInfo.tagline: Auténtica Cocina Italiana en el Corazón de Trumbull | Authentic Italian Cuisine in the Heart of Trumbull

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en el lote contiguo o en la calle.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Parking available in adjacent lot or street parking.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas de entrega locales.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.descriptionEs: Pan rústico tostado al horno con ajo, cubierto con tomates frescos marinados, albahaca y un toque de reducción de balsámico.
products.descriptionEn: Toasted rustic garlic bread topped with fresh marinated tomatoes, sweet basil, and a drizzle of balsamic reduction.

products.descriptionEs: Mejillones tiernos de agua salada salteados en vino blanco y nuestra clásica salsa marinara ligeramente picante.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh tender sea mussels sautéed in white wine garlic broth and our classic lightly spicy marinara sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Calamares ligeramente empanizados y fritos a la perfección dorada, servidos con salsa marinara casera y rodajas de limón.
products.descriptionEn: Lightly battered and golden-fried squid served with homemade marinara sauce and fresh lemon wedges.

products.descriptionEs: Queso mozzarella fresco empanizado y frito, servido con una rica salsa de tomate casera y albahaca.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh mozzarella breaded and fried to golden perfection, served with a rich homemade tomato and basil sauce.
Our traditional slow-simmered rich meat sauce served over fresh al dente spaghetti pasta.
Tender grilled chicken strips over fresh fettuccine pasta tossed in a rich, creamy parmesan and butter sauce.
Delicate ravioli stuffed with real lobster meat, served in a smooth creamy pink vodka and tomato sauce.
Penne pasta tossed with Italian prosciutto in a creamy tomato vodka sauce finished with parmesan cheese.
Layers of lightly battered eggplant, marinara sauce, mozzarella, and parmesan cheese baked to bubbly perfection.
Breaded chicken breast topped with marinara sauce and melted mozzarella cheese, served with a side of spaghetti.
Tender medallions of veal sautéed with fresh wild mushrooms in a rich, flavorful Marsala wine reduction.
An abundant mix of shrimp, mussels, clams, and calamari served over linguine in a white wine or marinara sauce.
Refreshing sparkling Italian beverage made with real Mediterranean citrus fruit juice.
Classic Italian dessert made with espresso-soaked ladyfingers, rich mascarpone cream, and cocoa powder.
Crispy pastry shell filled with sweet ricotta cream and chocolate chips.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, ofrecemos varias opciones vegetarianas y podemos preparar pastas sin gluten bajo solicitud.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer various vegetarian choices and can prepare gluten-free pasta upon request.

faqs.aEs: Aceptamos clientes sin reservación y reservaciones por teléfono, especialmente recomendadas para fines de semana.
faqs.aEn: We welcome walk-ins and phone reservations, which are strongly recommended for weekend dining.

faqs.qEs: ¿Ofrecen servicio para llevar o entrega a domicilio?
faqs.qEn: Do you offer takeout or delivery?
faqs.aEs: Sí, tenemos servicio para llevar llamando directamente y también trabajamos con plataformas locales.
faqs.aEn: Yes, takeout is available by calling directly, and we also partner with local delivery apps.
